features.quote: Max Turns: Capped at 15 iterations per run.
features.justification_quote: Degradation typically manifests between turns 4 and 8.

features.quote: The harness will automatically terminate the run early and assign a "Maximum Degradation" score if the exact same executable code block is generated by the model three times consecutively.
features.justification_quote: This prevents wasting API credits over 15 turns of an identical bash script.
